scripts.test: bun run --cwd server test && bun run --cwd web test

DIRECTORY.description: D1 database for accounts and sessions. Migrations run on every deploy.

MEDIA.description: R2 bucket for photos, videos, files and stickers. Keep `R2_BUCKET` the same as its name. After deploying, connect a custom domain, set CORS and create an API token (see the README).

BETTER_AUTH_URL.description: The app's public URL, for example `https://web-chat-app.<subdomain>.workers.dev`. Fill in after deploying, in `wrangler.jsonc` of your new repository (see the README).

OAUTH_DISCOVERY_URL.description: Your OpenID Connect provider's `/.well-known/openid-configuration` URL. Fill in after deploying, in `wrangler.jsonc` of your new repository (see the README).

OAUTH_CLIENT_ID.description: Client ID registered with your OpenID Connect provider. Fill in after deploying, in `wrangler.jsonc` of your new repository (see the README).

R2_ACCOUNT_ID.description: Your Cloudflare account ID, used for the R2 S3 endpoint. Fill in after deploying, in `wrangler.jsonc` of your new repository (see the README).

R2_BUCKET.description: Name of the media bucket. Must match the R2 bucket above.

MEDIA_ORIGIN.description: The media bucket's custom domain, for example `https://r2.example.com`. Read at build time: edit it in `wrangler.jsonc`, not in the dashboard.

VAPID_PUBLIC_KEY.description: Optional. Web Push public key, paired with the `VAPID_PRIVATE_KEY` secret. Generate a pair with `bunx web-push generate-vapid-keys`. Read at build time: edit it in `wrangler.jsonc`. Without it, notifications are off.

BETTER_AUTH_SECRET.description: Cookie signing key, at least 32 random bytes. Generate one with `openssl rand -base64 32`.

OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET.description: Client secret from your OpenID Connect provider. If you haven't registered the client yet, enter a placeholder and replace it later with `wrangler secret put`.

R2_ACCESS_KEY_ID.description: Access key ID of an R2 API token with Object Read & Write on the media bucket. Enter a placeholder if you don't have one yet.

R2_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY.description: Secret access key of the same R2 API token. Enter a placeholder if you don't have one yet.
